scope: Bounded extension of W7 DOI-oriented ancestry representation; proposal only for W9 integration.
scientific_rationale: Absence of a DOI is not evidence of absence of ancestry. A source-explicit predecessor with an unambiguous bibliographic identity must be representable without fabricating DOI metadata.

rules: doi must match a DOI syntax and be source-verified
doi_status must explicitly record that no DOI was established from the authoritative records checked and that none may be invented
title alone is never sufficient identity
authors, year, venue/proceedings, and pages/article number when applicable are mandatory
at least one stable bibliographic locator or an immutable local source artifact receipt is required
local_node_id is repository-local only and must start rt-biblio-
local_node_id must not match DOI syntax and must never be exported as an external identifier

local_id_rule.construction: rt-biblio-<human-readable-slug>-<12-hex sha256 prefix of normalized bibliographic identity>

all_required: descendant contains an explicit adaptation/extension/implementation-descended relation, not citation alone
a specific inherited operator, mechanism, architecture, or parameterization is named
source edition and citation locus are recorded
disallowed_shortcuts: transitivity without each intermediate edge being independently supported

fail_closed_rules: Never fabricate DOI metadata or a missing edition.
Reject a repository-local node identifier that resembles a DOI.
Citation alone cannot become direct ancestry.
Shared authorship cannot become direct ancestry.
Broad framework membership cannot become exact model descent.
UNDERDETERMINED edges cannot be used as independence evidence.
No W8-A artifact may set global independence true.
W8-A does not rewrite W7 ORIGINAL_NATIVE_PROFILES_v1.json or PAIR_TRIAGE_MATRIX.json.
